offering_description.value: Alight provides employee benefits software and administration services to employers across health, wealth, wellbeing, leave and healthcare navigation. It combines benefits management, personalization and data analytics in a single platform for employers and their employees.

quotes.quote: Through the administration of employee benefits, Alight helps clients gain a benefits advantage while building a healthy and financially secure workforce by unifying the benefits ecosystem across health, wealth, wellbeing, absence management and navigation.

Our Alight Worklife ® platform empowers employers to gain a deeper understanding of their workforce and engage them throughout life’s most important moments with personalized benefits management and data-driven insights, leading to increased employee wellbeing, engagement and productivity.
